sentences.zh: 天福三年正月戊申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of the third year of Tianfu, the wushen day, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; the guard of honor followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of Tianfu 3, the wushen day, the emperor entered the Chongyuan Hall to receive the New Year court congratulations, with the guard of honor arrayed according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 己酉，百官守司，以太史先奏日蝕故也。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, all officials remained at their posts, because the Grand Astrologer had first reported an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the entire bureaucracy stayed at their posts, since the court astronomer had earlier announced an expected solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 至是不虧，內外稱賀。

translations.literal: When the moment came, the sun was not eclipsed, and inside and outside the court offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: When the hour arrived the sun showed no eclipse, and court and capital alike celebrated.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，是夜以上元張燈於京城，縱都人遊樂，帝御大寧宮門樓觀之。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, that night for the Upper Yuan Festival lanterns were hung throughout the capital, the people of the metropolis were allowed to roam in pleasure, and the Emperor mounted the gate tower of the Daning Palace to watch.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, that night the capital was lit for the Lantern Festival, the urban populace was free to roam and revel, and the emperor watched from the gate tower of the Daning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，端明殿學士、禮部侍郎和凝兼判度支；

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, He Ning, Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Rites, was additionally assigned to adjudicate the Department of Public Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, He Ning, Duanming Hall academician and Vice Minister of Rites, was given concurrent charge of the Department of Public Revenue;

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎、判度支王松改尚書刑部侍郎；

translations.literal: Wang Song, Vice Minister of Works and acting head of the Department of Public Revenue, was transferred to Vice Minister of Punishments in the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Song, Vice Minister of Works who had been acting over Public Revenue, became Vice Minister of Punishments in the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 戶部郎中高延賞改左諫議大夫，充諸道鹽鐵轉運副使。

translations.literal: Gao Yanshang, Director in the Ministry of Revenue, was made Left Remonstrance Censor and appointed Deputy Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yanshang, Director in the Ministry of Revenue, became Left Remonstrance Censor and deputy commissioner for salt-and-iron transport across the circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以前右諫議大夫薛融為左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the former Right Remonstrance Censor Xue Rong was made Left Remonstrance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the former Right Remonstrance Censor Xue Rong was appointed Left Remonstrance Censor.

sentences.zh: 前興元節度使張筠卒於西京，輟視朝一日。

translations.literal: The former military governor of Xingyuan, Zhang Yun, died in the Western Capital; court audiences were suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yun, former governor of Xingyuan, died in Luoyang, and the court suspended audiences for one day.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：太常禮院申：「準故事，前節度使無例輟朝。

translations.literal: (The Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted: "According to precedent, there is no instance of suspending court for a former military governor.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "By precedent, no former governor had ever occasioned a suspension of court.

sentences.zh: 」敕：「宜特輟一日朝參。」）〉

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "It is fitting to make an exceptional suspension of court attendance for one day.")]
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered: "Suspend court attendance for one day as a special exception.")]

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，左散騎常侍張允進《駁赦論》。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the gengchen day, Zhang Yun, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, submitted the "Critique of Amnesties."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengchen day, Zhang Yun, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, presented his "Critique of Amnesties."

sentences.zh: 帝覽而嘉之，降詔獎飾，仍付史館。

translations.literal: The Emperor read it and commended it, issued an edict of reward and praise, and had it forwarded to the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read it with approval, issued an edict of commendation, and ordered it deposited in the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，荊南節度使高從誨加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, received an increase in his fief domain and enfeoffment income.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Gao Conghui, governor of Jingnan, was granted additional fief income and a tangible enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 戊子，翰林學士李浣賜緋魚袋。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, the Hanlin Academician Li Huan was granted the crimson robe and fish tally.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Hanlin Academician Li Huan was awarded the crimson court robe and fish tally.

sentences.zh: 以尚書屯田員外郎、知制誥吳承範為庫部員外郎，充樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: Wu Chengfang, Outer Assistant Director in the Ministry of Agriculture and drafter of imperial documents, was made Outer Assistant Director in the Ministry of the Treasury and appointed Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chengfang, Outer Assistant Director in the Ministry of Agriculture and imperial drafter, became Outer Assistant Director in the Ministry of the Treasury and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，御劄曰：「曾有宣示百官，令進封事，今據到者未及十人。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, an imperial rescript stated: "I once announced to all officials that they should submit sealed memorials; now those received number fewer than ten.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, an imperial rescript read: "I once directed every official to submit sealed memorials; fewer than ten have arrived.

sentences.zh: 朕雖無德，自行敕後已是數月，至於假手於人，也合各有一件事敷奏。

translations.literal: Although I lack virtue, several months have passed since I issued that edict; even if one relies on others, each person ought to have presented at least one matter for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Though I am without merit, months have passed since that order; even those who speak through others should each have brought at least one matter before the throne.

sentences.zh: 食祿於朝，豈當如是！

translations.literal: Drawing salary from the court—how can it be thus!
translations.idiomatic: You draw the court's salary—is this how you serve?!

sentences.zh: 言而不用，朕所甘心；

translations.literal: If you speak and I do not employ your counsel, that is what I can accept with equanimity;
translations.idiomatic: If you speak and I do not heed you, I can accept that;

sentences.zh: 用而不言，誰之責也。

translations.literal: If I employ counsel but you do not speak—whose responsibility is that?
translations.idiomatic: but if counsel is needed and you stay silent, whose fault is that.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，制武清軍節度使馬希萼改威武軍節度使。

translations.literal: " On the bingshen day, an order was issued that Ma Xi'e, military governor of the Wuqing Army, be transferred to military governor of the Weiwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: " On the bingshen day, Ma Xi'e, governor of the Wuqing Army, was reassigned as governor of the Weiwu Army.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，中書上言：「《禮經》云：『禮不諱嫌名，二名不偏諱。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the Secretariat submitted: "The Book of Rites says: 'In ritual one does not avoid homophonic names; for a double name one does not avoid only one of the two characters.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Secretariat memorialized: "The Book of Rites states: 'Ritual does not require avoiding homophonic names, and a double personal name is not to be half-avoided.

sentences.zh: 』註云：「『嫌名，謂音聲相近，若禹與宇、邱與區也。

translations.literal: ' The commentary says: "'Homophonic name' means sounds that are close, as Yu and yu, or Qiu and qu.
translations.idiomatic: ' The commentary explains: 'A homophonic name is one whose sound is near that of the taboo, as Yu and yu, or Qiu and qu.

sentences.zh: 二名不偏諱，謂孔子之母名徵在，言在不稱徵，言徵不稱在。

translations.literal: 'Not half-avoiding a double name' means that Confucius's mother was named Zhengzai: when one says zai one does not say zheng, and when one says zheng one does not say zai.
translations.idiomatic: 'Not half-avoiding a double name' means that Confucius's mother was called Zhengzai: when saying zai one does not use zheng, and when saying zheng one does not use zai.

sentences.zh: 』此古禮也。

translations.literal: ' This is the ancient ritual.
translations.idiomatic: ' That is the ancient rule.

sentences.zh: 唐太宗二名並諱，玄宗二名亦同；

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang avoided both characters of his double name, and Emperor Xuanzong did the same;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong of Tang tabooed both characters of his name, and Emperor Xuanzong did likewise;

sentences.zh: 人姓與國諱音聲相近是嫌名者，亦改姓氏，與古禮有異。

translations.literal: when a person's surname was a homophonic name close to the imperial taboo, the surname was also changed—this differs from the ancient ritual.
translations.idiomatic: surnames homophonous with the imperial taboo were also changed—at odds with antiquity.

sentences.zh: 廟諱平聲字，即不諱余三聲；

translations.literal: For a temple taboo that is a level-tone character, the other three tones are not tabooed;
translations.idiomatic: When the ancestral taboo is a level-tone character, the other three tones need not be avoided;

sentences.zh: 諱側聲，即不諱平聲字。

translations.literal: when a departing-tone character is tabooed, level-tone forms of the character are not tabooed.
translations.idiomatic: when the taboo is in a departing tone, the level-tone form is not tabooed.

sentences.zh: 所諱字正文及偏旁闕點畫，望依令式施行。

translations.literal: For the tabooed character itself, the main form and the omission of strokes in the radicals and components—may these be carried out according to the statutes and regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Omission of strokes in the full character and its components should follow the current regulations.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「朝廷之制，今古相沿，道在人宏，禮非天降。

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "Court institutions are handed down from past to present; the Way is enlarged by human effort, and ritual is not bestowed from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne replied: "Court custom is handed down through the ages; the Way is enlarged by men, and ritual does not fall from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 方開歷數，虔奉祖宗，雖逾孔子之文，未爽周公之訓。

translations.literal: As we inaugurate our dynasty's mandate and devoutly serve our ancestors, though we go beyond the text of Confucius, we do not depart from the instruction of the Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: As we inaugurate our mandate and reverently serve the ancestors, we may exceed Confucius in letter yet remain true to the Duke of Zhou in spirit.

sentences.zh: 所為二名及嫌名事，宜依唐禮施行。」

translations.literal: As to the matters of double names and homophonic names, Tang ritual should be followed in practice."
translations.idiomatic: Matters of double names and homophonic names are to follow Tang practice."

sentences.zh: （案：太原縣有史匡翰碑，立於天福八年。

translations.literal: (Note: In Taiyuan County there is a stele for Shi Kuanghan, erected in the eighth year of Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: (Note: Taiyuan County has a stele for Shi Kuanghan, erected in Tianfu 8.

sentences.zh: 匡翰，建瑭之子也。

translations.literal: Kuanghan was the son of Jiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Kuanghan was the son of Jiantang.

sentences.zh: 碑於「瑭」字空文以避諱，而建瑭父敬思，仍書「敬」字，蓋當時避諱之體如此。）〉

translations.literal: On the stele the character tang in "Jiantang" was left blank to avoid the taboo, yet Jiantang's father Jingsi still has the character jing written—such was the form of taboo avoidance at that time.)]
translations.idiomatic: On the stele the character for tang in Jiantang's name is left blank for the taboo, yet his father Jingsi's character jing is written in full—illustrating how taboo was observed at the time.)]

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天和節，宴近臣於廣政殿。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the Tianhe Festival, the Emperor feasted his close ministers in the Guangzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the Tianhe Festival, the emperor entertained his close ministers in the Guangzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，以尚書吏部侍郎盧詹為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the dinghai day, Lu Zhan, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the dinghai day, Lu Zhan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人李詳上疏：「請沙汰在朝文武臣僚，以減冗食。

translations.literal: Li Xiang, Secretariat Drafter, submitted a memorial: "I request that civil and military officials at court be sifted and culled to reduce redundant salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiang, Secretariat drafter, memorialized: "I ask that civil and military officials at court be reviewed and culled to cut redundant stipends.

sentences.zh: 仍條貫藩侯郡守，凡遇傅恩，不得多奏衙前職員，妄邀恩澤。

translations.literal: Regulations should also be drawn up for feudatory lords and prefectural governors: whenever favor is granted, they must not memorialize excessively for yamen staff positions or seek favors without warrant.
translations.idiomatic: Rules should also bind feudatory lords and prefects: when favors are granted, they must not flood the throne with requests for yamen staff or seek unearned largesse.

sentences.zh: 」疏奏，嘉之。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, [the Emperor] commended it.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was received with approval.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宣武軍節度、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都招討使楊光遠加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Yang Guangyuan, military governor of the Xuanwu Army, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, and Grand Commander of the Guangjin Prefecture campaign army, was additionally made Chief Councillor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Yang Guangyuan, governor of the Xuanwu Army, commander of the palace guard horse and foot, and grand campaign commander of the Guangjin headquarters, was additionally appointed Chief Councillor.

sentences.zh: 昭義節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都排陣使杜重威，河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使、廣晉府行營馬步都虞候侯益，並加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, military governor of Zhaoyi, Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, and Chief Array Marshal of the Guangjin campaign army, and Hou Yi, military governor of Heyang with concurrent command of the left and right wings of the Fengguo Army and Chief Adjutant of horse and foot for the Guangjin campaign army, were both made Honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei, governor of Zhaoyi, palace cavalry commander, and chief array marshal of the Guangjin campaign, and Hou Yi, governor of Heyang, commander of the Fengguo left and right wings, and chief adjutant of horse and foot for the campaign, were both promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、岐王李從嚴進封秦王，平盧軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、臨淄王王建立進封東平王。

translations.literal: Li Congyan, military governor of Fengxiang, Honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Chief Councillor, and Prince of Qi, was advanced to Prince of Qin; Wang Jianli, military governor of the Pinglu Army, Honorary Grand Guardian, concurrent Chief Councillor, and Prince of Linzi, was advanced to Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congyan, governor of Fengxiang, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Chief Councillor, and Prince of Qi, was raised to Prince of Qin; Wang Jianli, governor of Pinglu, Honorary Grand Guardian, Chief Councillor, and Prince of Linzi, was raised to Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，泰寧軍節度使李從溫、西京留守京兆尹李周、歸德軍節度使趙在禮，並加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Li Congwen, military governor of the Taining Army; Li Zhou, Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao and Western Capital regent; and Zhao Zaili, military governor of the Guide Army, were all additionally made Palace Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Li Congwen, governor of Taining; Li Zhou, metropolitan governor of Jingzhao and Luoyang regent; and Zhao Zaili, governor of Guide, were all additionally appointed Palace Attendants.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸道藩侯郡守皆等第加恩。

translations.literal: That month, feudatory lords and prefectural governors in all circuits received graded increases of favor.
translations.idiomatic: That month every feudatory lord and prefect in the circuits received graded promotions and favors.

sentences.zh: 改雍熙樓為章和樓，避廟諱也。

translations.literal: The Yongxi Tower was renamed the Zhanghe Tower, to avoid the temple taboo.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongxi Tower was renamed Zhanghe Tower to avoid the ancestral taboo.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, the dingwei day, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court, the guard of honor as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, the dingwei day, the emperor entered the Chongyuan Hall for court, with the guard of honor arrayed according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔應諸州縣名犯廟諱者並改之。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, an edict ordered that all prefecture and county names that violated the temple taboo were to be changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict ordered every prefecture and county whose name violated the ancestral taboo to be renamed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以楊光遠男承祚為檢校工部尚書、左威衛將軍、駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Yang Guangyuan's son Chengzuo was made Honorary Minister of Works, General of the Left Weiwu Guard, and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Yang Guangyuan's son Chengzuo was appointed Honorary Minister of Works, general of the Left Weiwu Guard, and commissioner of the imperial son-in-law's household.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，魏府行營步軍都指揮使、檢校司徒、右神武統軍王周加檢校太保。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Wang Zhou, Commander of the campaign infantry at the Wei Prefecture headquarters, Honorary Minister of Education, and Commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was made Honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Wang Zhou, campaign infantry commander at Wei Prefecture, Honorary Minister of Education, and commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was promoted to Honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，故振武節度使李嗣本贈太尉。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, the late Li Siben, former military governor of Zhenwu, was posthumously made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the late Li Siben, former governor of Zhenwu, was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：「中外臣僚，帶平章事、侍中、中書令及諸道節度使，並許私門立戟，仍並官給及據官品依令式處分。」

translations.literal: On the jisi day, an edict stated: "Civil and military officials within and without the court who bear the titles of Chief Councillor, Palace Attendant, Chief Councillor of the Secretariat, or military governor of a circuit are all permitted to erect halberds at their private gates; halberds and stipends are to be supplied by the state according to rank and in conformity with the statutes."
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, an edict declared: "Officials at court and in the provinces who hold the titles of Chief Councillor, Palace Attendant, Chief Councillor of the Secretariat, or military governor may erect ceremonial halberds at their private gates; the halberds and stipends are to be supplied by the state according to rank and statute."

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，右監門衛上將軍王彥璘卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the dingchou day, Wang Yanlin, Senior General of the Right Jianmen Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingchou day, Wang Yanlin, senior general of the Right Jianmen Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以太子詹事王居敏制置安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽事。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Wang Jumin, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was assigned to oversee the salt monopoly at the Anyi and Jie County ponds.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Wang Jumin, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was put in charge of the salt monopoly at the Anyi and Jie County ponds.

sentences.zh: 左諫議大夫薛融上疏，請停修洛京大內。

translations.literal: Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor, submitted a memorial requesting a halt to construction of the great inner palace at the Luoyang capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor, memorialized asking that work on the great inner palace at Luoyang be stopped.

sentences.zh: 優詔褒之，尋罷營造。

translations.literal: A gracious edict praised him, and soon construction was halted.
translations.idiomatic: A gracious edict commended him, and construction was soon halted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，翰林學士、尚書者工部郎中、知制誥竇貞固改中書舍人充職。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin Academician, Director in the Ministry of Works in the Secretariat, and drafter of imperial documents, was transferred to Secretariat Drafter to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician, Director in the Ministry of Works, and imperial drafter, was transferred to Secretariat drafter in the same capacity.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書致仕蕭蘧卒，贈右僕射。

translations.literal: Xiao Sui, retired Minister of Revenue, died and was posthumously made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sui, retired Minister of Revenue, died and was posthumously honored as Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔貢舉宜權停一年，以員闕少而選人多，常調有淹滯故也。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the civil service examinations be provisionally suspended for one year, because vacancies were few while candidates were many and routine appointees were backing up.
translations.idiomatic: An edict suspended the civil examinations for one year, since posts were few, candidates many, and routine appointees were backing up.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔：「尚書司門應管諸闕令丞等，宜準唐天成四年四月四日敕，本司不得差補，只委闕鎮使鈐轄，見差補者，並畫時勒停訖奏聞。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, an edict stated: "For all acting magistrates and assistants under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Revenue's Gate Office, the edict of the fourth day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Tiancheng in Tang should be followed: the ministry itself may not make provisional appointments; authority is vested solely in the garrison commissioners of the vacant posts; those now provisionally appointed are all to be stopped at once and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an edict ordered: "Acting magistrates and assistants under the Gate Office of the Ministry of Revenue shall follow the Tang edict of 4 April Tiancheng 4: the ministry may not fill posts on its own; only the garrison commissioners of vacant posts have authority; anyone now provisionally appointed is to be stopped at once and reported.

sentences.zh: 應常帶使相節度使，自楊光遠已下凡七人，並改鄉里名號。」

translations.literal: All military governors who regularly bear the commissioner-and-councillor designation, seven persons from Yang Guangyuan downward, are to change their native-place designations."
translations.idiomatic: Every governor who regularly holds the commissioner-and-councillor designation—seven men from Yang Guangyuan down—must change his native-place designation."

sentences.zh: 七月丙午朔，差左諫議大夫薛融、秘書監呂琦、駕部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事劉皞、刑部郎中司徒詡、大理正張仁彖，同共詳定唐明宗朝編敕。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, the bingwu day, Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor; Lu Qi, Director of the Palace Library; Liu Hao, Outer Assistant Director in the Ministry of Transport with concurrent Remonstrance Censor and chief supervising censor; Situ Xu, Director in the Ministry of Punishments; and Zhang Renben, Senior Rectifier of the Court of Judicial Review, were jointly assigned to examine and fix the compiled edicts of the reign of Emperor Mingzong of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the seventh month, the bingwu day, Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor; Lu Qi, Director of the Palace Library; Liu Hao, Outer Assistant Director in the Ministry of Transport with concurrent supervising censor; Situ Xu, Director in the Ministry of Punishments; and Zhang Renben, senior rectifier of the Court of Judicial Review, were jointly assigned to revise the compiled edicts of Emperor Mingzong of Tang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，御史中丞王延改尚書右丞，尚書右丞盧導改尚書吏部侍郎，以左諫議大夫薛融為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Wang Yan, Censor-in-Chief, was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Lu Dao, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel; Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor, was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Wang Yan, Censor-in-Chief, became Right Vice Director; Lu Dao, Right Vice Director, became Vice Minister of Personnel; and Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor, became Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，制皇帝受命寶，以「受天明命，惟德允昌」為文。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the Imperial Seal of Received Mandate was ordered made, with the inscription "Receiving Heaven's clear mandate, virtue alone brings prosperity."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the imperial Seal of Received Mandate was ordered cast with the inscription "Receiving Heaven's clear mandate—only virtue brings lasting prosperity."

sentences.zh: 據《六典》，受命寶者，天子修封禪、禮神祇則用之，其始皆破皇業錢以制之。

translations.literal: According to the Six Offices Compendium, the Seal of Received Mandate is used when the Son of Heaven performs the feng and shan rites or sacrifices to the spirits; at the outset it was always cast by melting imperial-estate coin.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Tang Six Offices Compendium, the Seal of Received Mandate is used when the Son of Heaven performs the feng and shan rites or sacrifices to the spirits; it was originally cast from melted imperial-estate coin.

sentences.zh: 皇業者，藩邸主事之所有也。

translations.literal: "Imperial estate" refers to property held by the chief steward of the princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: "Imperial estate" coin was property of the chief steward of the princely household.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：天福三年六月，中書門下奏：「準敕，制皇帝受命寶。

translations.literal: (The Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium: In the sixth month of the third year of Tianfu, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "In accordance with the edict, the Imperial Seal of Received Mandate is to be made.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium, in the sixth month of Tianfu 3 the Secretariat and Chancellery reported: "By edict, the Imperial Seal of Received Mandate is to be made.

sentences.zh: 今按唐貞觀十六年，太宗文皇帝所刻之璽，白玉為螭首，其文曰『皇帝景命，有德者昌』。

translations.literal: We now find that in the sixteenth year of Zhenguan in Tang, the seal cut for Emperor Taizong had a white-jade chi-dragon knob, and its inscription read 'The Son of Heaven's bright mandate—he of virtue prospers.'
translations.idiomatic: We find that in Tang Zhenguan 16 the seal cut for Emperor Taizong had a white-jade chi-dragon knob inscribed 'The Son of Heaven's bright mandate—he of virtue prospers.'

translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered: "Carve it with the inscription 'Receiving Heaven's clear mandate—only virtue brings lasting prosperity.'")]

sentences.zh: 壬戌，虞部郎中、知制誥於遘改中書舍人。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Yu Hun, Director in the Ministry of Forestry and drafter of imperial documents, was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Yu Hun, Director in the Ministry of Forestry and imperial drafter, became Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 宰臣趙瑩、桑維翰、李崧各改鄉里名號。

translations.literal: The chief councillors Zhao Ying, Sang Weihan, and Li Song each changed their native-place designations.
translations.idiomatic: Chief councillors Zhao Ying, Sang Weihan, and Li Song each changed their native-place designations.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使高從誨本貫汴州浚儀縣王畿鄉表節東坊，改為擁旌鄉浴鳳裏。

translations.literal: Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, whose native registration had been Biaojie East Lane, Wangji Township, Junyi County, Bian Prefecture, changed it to Yufeng Lane, Yongjing Township.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Conghui, governor of Jingnan, changed his registered native place from Biaojie East Lane, Wangji Township, Junyi County, Bian Prefecture, to Yufeng Lane, Yongjing Township.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，以左僕射劉句為契丹冊禮使，左散騎常侍韋勛副之，給事中盧重為契丹皇太后冊禮使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the wuyin day, Liu Xu, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made envoy for the Khitan investiture rites, with Wei Xun, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, as deputy; Lu Chong, Attending Drafter, was made envoy for the Khitan empress dowager's investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuyin day, Liu Xu, Left Vice Director, was appointed envoy for the Khitan investiture rites, with Wei Xun, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, as deputy; Lu Chong, Attending Drafter, was envoy for the Khitan empress dowager's investiture.

sentences.zh: 壬午，魏府軍前奏，前澶州刺史馮暉自逆城來歸。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, the army at the Wei Prefecture front reported that the former prefect of Chanzhou, Feng Hui, had come over from the rebel city.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Wei Prefecture front reported that Feng Hui, former prefect of Chanzhou, had surrendered from the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，境內旱，民多流散。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported drought within its borders and many people scattered in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Prefecture reported drought within its borders and widespread displacement of the populace.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨寰宇，每念生民，務切撫綏，期於富庶，屬干戈之未戢，慮徭役之或煩。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Since I took the realm, I have constantly thought of the people, striving earnestly to comfort and pacify them and hoping for wealth and plenty; yet while arms have not yet been laid down, I fear that corvée labor may become burdensome.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Since I took the throne I have thought constantly of the people, striving to comfort them and bring prosperity; yet while war is not yet ended, I fear corvée may still burden them.

sentences.zh: 惟彼中山，偶經夏旱，因茲疾苦，遽至流移，達我聽聞，深懷憫惻。

translations.literal: Zhongshan alone has by chance suffered summer drought; through this hardship people have swiftly been driven to flight; reaching my ears, this stirs deep compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongshan alone has suffered summer drought; hardship has driven people to flight; learning of this, I am deeply moved to pity.

sentences.zh: 應定州所差軍前夫役逃戶夏秋稅並放。

translations.literal: All summer and autumn taxes owed by households that fled before corvée for troops levied by Ding Prefecture are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All summer and autumn taxes owed by households that fled before corvée for Ding Prefecture's troop levies are remitted.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，襄州奏，漢江水漲一丈一尺。

translations.literal: " On the jiashen day, Xiang Prefecture reported that the Han River had risen one zhang and one chi.
translations.idiomatic: " On the jiashen day, Xiang Prefecture reported the Han River had risen one zhang and one chi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以前澶州刺史馮暉為檢校太保，充義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the former prefect of Chanzhou, Feng Hui, was made Honorary Grand Guardian and appointed military governor of the Yicheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Feng Hui, former prefect of Chanzhou, was appointed Honorary Grand Guardian and governor of the Yicheng Army.

sentences.zh: 詔：「河府、同州、絳州等三處災旱，逃移人戶下所欠累年殘稅，並今年夏稅差科，及麥苗子沿征諸色錢物等並放。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "In the three regions of Hezhong Prefecture, Tong Prefecture, and Jiang Prefecture, which suffered disaster and drought, all arrears of residual taxes for years past owed by households that fled, as well as this year's summer levies and assessments, and all miscellaneous monies collected along with the wheat-seed tax, are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "In Hezhong, Tong, and Jiang prefectures, stricken by disaster and drought, all arrears of residual tax owed by fleeing households, this year's summer levies and assessments, and all miscellaneous collections including the wheat-seed tax, are remitted.

sentences.zh: 其逃戶下秋苗，據見檢到數不計是元額及出剩頃畝，並放一半。

translations.literal: For autumn grain tax on fleeing households, according to the acreage actually verified on inspection, regardless of whether it matched the original quota or showed surplus fields, half is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: For autumn grain tax on fleeing households, half is remitted on the acreage actually verified, whether it matched the original quota or showed surplus fields.

sentences.zh: 委觀察使散行曉諭，專切招攜。

translations.literal: Commission the observation commissioners to circulate proclamations explaining this and devote themselves to summoning and comforting the people.
translations.idiomatic: Observation commissioners are to circulate proclamations and devote themselves to summoning people back.

sentences.zh: 應歸業戶人，仍指揮逐縣切加安撫。

translations.literal: Households that return to their occupations are to be ordered, county by county, to receive earnest reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: Households that return to farming are to be reassured earnestly, county by county.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，翰林學士、中書舍人竇貞固上言：「請令文武百僚，逐司之內，各奏舉一人，述其人有某能，堪為某官某職。

translations.literal: " On the bingshen day, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, submitted: "I request that all civil and military officials, within each bureau, each memorialize one person, stating what abilities that person possesses and what office or post he is fit to hold.
translations.idiomatic: " On the bingshen day, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician and Secretariat drafter, proposed: "Let every civil and military official, within each bureau, nominate one person, stating his abilities and the office or post for which he is fit.

sentences.zh: 據所薦否藏，定舉主黜陟。」

translations.literal: According to whether the recommendation proves true or false, the recommender's promotion or demotion shall be decided."
translations.idiomatic: According to whether the nominee proves worthy, the nominator's promotion or demotion shall be decided."

sentences.zh: （《宋史·竇貞固傳》載此疏，略云：為國之要，進賢是先。

translations.literal: (The Song History biography of Dou Zhengu records this memorial, which in summary says: The essential of governing a state is to advance the worthy—that comes first.
translations.idiomatic: (The biography of Dou Zhengu in the Song History records this memorial, which in summary says: The essential of governing a state is to advance the worthy—that comes first.

sentences.zh: 陛下方樹丕基，宜求多士。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is just now establishing a great foundation; you should seek many scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is just establishing the foundation of the dynasty; you should seek many men of talent.

sentences.zh: 乞降詔百僚，令各司議定一人，有何能識，堪何職官，朝廷依奏用之。

translations.literal: I beg that an edict be issued to all officials ordering each bureau to deliberate and fix on one person, stating what abilities and knowledge he has and what office he is fit for, and that the court appoint him according to the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that an edict go to all officials ordering each bureau to select one man, stating his abilities and the office for which he is fit, and that the court appoint him as recommended.

sentences.zh: 若能符薦引，果謂當才，所奏之官，望加獎賞。

translations.literal: If the nominee matches the recommendation and is truly deemed suitable, the official who memorialized him should receive added reward.
translations.idiomatic: If the nominee proves worthy, the nominator should be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 如乖其舉，或涉徇私，所奏之官，宜加黜罰。

translations.literal: If the nomination fails or involves private favoritism, the official who memorialized should be demoted or punished.
translations.idiomatic: If the nomination fails or involves favoritism, the nominator should be demoted or punished.

sentences.zh: 自然官由德序，位以才升。

translations.literal: Naturally offices will follow virtue in ordering, and positions will rise by talent.
translations.idiomatic: Then office will follow virtue and rank will rise by talent.

sentences.zh: 三人同行，尚聞擇善；

translations.literal: When three walk together, one still hears of choosing the good;
translations.idiomatic: Even when three walk together, one may still choose the good;

sentences.zh: 十目所視，必不濫知。

translations.literal: what ten eyes behold will surely not be known indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: what ten eyes watch cannot be known carelessly.

sentences.zh: 臣職在論思，敢陳狂狷。）〉

translations.literal: My office lies in deliberation and reflection; I dare offer this reckless presumption.)]
translations.idiomatic: My duty is deliberation and counsel; I dare offer this bold memorial.)]

sentences.zh: 疏奏，嘉之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and praised.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and commended.

sentences.zh: 仍令文武百官於搢紳之內、草澤之中，知灼然有才器者，列名以奏。

translations.literal: Further, civil and military officials of all ranks were ordered, from within the gentry and from commoners in obscurity, to list by name and memorialize those clearly known to possess talent and ability.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were further ordered to nominate, from the gentry and from commoners, any person clearly possessed of talent and ability.

sentences.zh: 宴契丹冊禮使於廣政殿。

translations.literal: A banquet for the Khitan investiture envoys was held in the Guangzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan investiture envoys were entertained in the Guangzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，鄆州奏，陽谷縣界河決。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, Yanzhou reported that the river breached its banks at the boundary of Yanggu County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yanzhou reported a breach of the river on the Yanggu County border.

sentences.zh: 青州王建立奏，高麗國宿衛質子王仁翟乞放歸鄉里。

translations.literal: Wang Jianli of Qingzhou memorialized that Wang Renqi, a hostage prince on palace guard duty from Goryeo, begged release to return to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jianli of Qingzhou reported that the Goryeo hostage prince on palace guard duty, Wang Renqi, asked to be sent home.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鎮、邢、定三州奏，奉詔共差樂官六十七人往契丹。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Zhen, Xing, and Ding prefectures reported that by imperial order they had jointly dispatched sixty-seven music officers to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhen, Xing, and Ding reported that by edict they had jointly sent sixty-seven music officers to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔：「魏府城下，自屯軍已來，墳墓多經劚掘。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Below Weifu city, since troops were encamped, many tombs have been dug up.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Below Weifu city, since troops were encamped there, many graves have been excavated.

sentences.zh: 雖已差人收掩，今更遣太僕卿邢德昭往伸祭奠。」

translations.literal: Although men have already been sent to gather and reinter the remains, now the Grand Servant of the Imperial Stud Xing Dezhao is further sent to perform sacrifices and libations."
translations.idiomatic: Although reburial teams have already been sent, Grand Servant of the Imperial Stud Xing Dezhao is now dispatched to offer sacrifices."

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，宮苑使焦繼勛自軍前押範延光牙將馬諤賫歸命請罪表到闕。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiyou day, Palace Parks Commissioner Jiao Jixun brought from the front Ma E, a junior general of Fan Yanguang, escorting the surrender petition begging pardon, and arrived at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Palace Parks Commissioner Jiao Jixun arrived from the front escorting Ma E, a junior general of Fan Yanguang, bearing the surrender petition.

sentences.zh: 壬子，延光領部下將士素服於本府門俟命，有詔釋罪。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yanguang led his officers and troops in plain dress before his headquarters gate awaiting orders; an edict pardoned their offenses.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yanguang and his officers and troops waited in plain dress at his headquarters gate; an edict pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔司空兼門下侍郎、平章事馮道官一品，給門戟十六枝，中書侍郎平章事桑維翰、李崧給門戟十二枝。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict made Feng Dao, Grand Master and Vice Minister of the Secretariat with Grand Councilor status, rank first grade, granting sixteen gate halberds; Sang Weihan and Li Song, Vice Ministers of the Central Secretariat with Grand Councilor status, were each granted twelve gate halberds.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Feng Dao, Grand Master, Vice Minister of State, and Grand Councilor, was made first rank and granted sixteen gate halberds; Grand Councilors Sang Weihan and Li Song of the Central Secretariat were each granted twelve.

sentences.zh: 己未，宣遣靜鞭官劉守威、左金吾仗勘契官王英、司天臺雞叫學生商暉等並赴契丹。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an order sent Quiet-Whip Officer Liu Shouwei, Left Golden Crow Guard tally-inspector Wang Ying, Directorate of Astronomy roster student Shang Hui, and others all to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Quiet-Whip Officer Liu Shouwei, Left Golden Crow tally inspector Wang Ying, Directorate of Astronomy roster student Shang Hui, and others were dispatched to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，契丹使人往洛京般取趙氏公主。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Khitan envoys went to Luoyang to transport away Princess Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Khitan envoys went to Luoyang to escort Princess Zhao away.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·趙贊傳》：德鈞父子降晉，契丹盡錮之北去，贊獨與母公主留西洛。

translations.literal: (The Song History, biography of Zhao Zan: When Dejun and his son surrendered to Jin, the Khitan shackled them all and took them north; Zan alone remained in Western Luoyang with his mother the princess.
translations.idiomatic: (Biography of Zhao Zan in the Song History: When Dejun and his son surrendered to Jin, the Khitan shackled them and took them north; Zan alone remained in Western Luoyang with his mother the princess.

sentences.zh: 天福三年，晉祖命贊奉母歸薊門。）〉

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianfu, the Jin founder ordered Zan to escort his mother back to Jimen.)]
translations.idiomatic: In Tianfu 3, the Jin founder ordered Zan to escort his mother back to Jimen.)]

sentences.zh: 襄州奏，漢江水漲三丈，出岸害稼。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture reported that the Han River rose three zhang, overflowed its banks, and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang reported that the Han rose three zhang, overflowed, and damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 東都奏，洛陽水漲一丈五尺，壞下浮橋。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital reported that Luoyang's waters rose one zhang and five chi, destroying the lower pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital reported that Luoyang's waters rose fifteen chi and destroyed the lower pontoon bridge.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，于闐國王楊仁美遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On yichou, King Yang Renmei of Khotan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, King Yang Renmei of Khotan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 回鶻可汗遣使貢駝馬。

translations.literal: The Uyghur qaghan sent envoys bearing tribute of camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghur qaghan sent envoys with camels and horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，趙延壽進馬謝恩，放燕國長公主歸幽州。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Zhao Yanshou presented horses in thanks for grace; the Princess of Yan was released to return to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhao Yanshou presented horses in gratitude; the Princess of Yan was released to return to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 範延光差節度副使李式到闕，奉表首罪，兼進玉帶一條。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang sent his deputy military commissioner Li Shi to court, presenting a memorial confessing guilt and also offering one jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang sent deputy commissioner Li Shi to court with a confession and a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 遣宣徽南院使劉處讓權知魏府軍府事。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat Liu Churang was sent to act as provisional administrator of Weifu military prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Churang, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was sent to administer Weifu military affairs provisionally.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復範延光官爵，其制略曰：「頃朕始登大寶，未靜中原，六飛才及於京師，千里未通於懷抱。

translations.literal: On jisi, Fan Yanguang's offices and titles were restored; the edict in summary said: "Just now, as We first ascended the great throne, the Central Plains were not yet settled; the six-dragon carriage had only just reached the capital, and a thousand li still did not reach Our embrace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Fan Yanguang's rank was restored; the edict read in part: "When We first took the throne, the Central Plains were unsettled; Our chariot had scarcely reached the capital, and a thousand li still lay beyond Our grasp.

sentences.zh: 楚王求舊，方在遺簪；

translations.literal: The King of Chu sought the old—he was just at the lost hairpin;
translations.idiomatic: Like the King of Chu seeking an old minister, one was still at the lost hairpin;

sentences.zh: 曾子傳疑，忽成投杼。

translations.literal: When Zengzi passed on suspicion, it suddenly became casting away the shuttle.
translations.idiomatic: When Zengzi was suspected, the shuttle was cast aside in haste.

sentences.zh: 尋聞悛悔，遽戮奸回，干戈俄至於經時，雷雨因思於作解。

translations.literal: Soon We heard of repentance and amendment, and quickly executed treacherous villains; weapons of war lasted only a season, and thunder and rain brought thoughts of granting release.
translations.idiomatic: Soon repentance was heard and traitors were swiftly punished; arms had raged for a season, and thunder and rain recalled the blessing of release.

sentences.zh: 果馳賓介，疊貢表章，向丹闕以傾心，瀝衷誠而效順。

translations.literal: Envoys were indeed dispatched posthaste, memorials piled one upon another, turning the heart toward the vermilion gate and pouring forth sincerity in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came in haste, memorials piled high, hearts turned to the court, sincerity poured out in submission.

sentences.zh: 而況保全黎庶，完整甲兵，納款斯來，其功非細。

translations.literal: Moreover, preserving the common people and keeping armor and weapons intact—surrender came thus, and the merit was no small thing.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the people were spared and arms kept whole—such was his surrender, and the merit was great.

sentences.zh: 得不特頒鐵契，重建牙章，封本郡之土茅，移樂郊之旌鉞。

translations.literal: How could We not specially issue an iron covenant, rebuild the tally-seal insignia, enfeoff him with the local earth and thatch, and transfer to him the standards and axes of the happy suburb.
translations.idiomatic: We could hardly fail to issue a special iron covenant, restore his command insignia, enfeoff him with the fief of his own circuit, and transfer to him the standard and axes of a new command.

sentences.zh: 至於將吏，鹹降絲綸。

translations.literal: As for officers and clerks, all received imperial rescripts.
translations.idiomatic: His officers and clerks all received imperial rescripts.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: O!

sentences.zh: 上穹之運四時，不愆者信；

translations.literal: The vast dome runs the four seasons—what does not err is faithfulness;
translations.idiomatic: Heaven runs the four seasons—inconstancy is the only fault;

sentences.zh: 大道之崇三寶，所重者慈。

translations.literal: The Great Way honors the three treasures—what it values is compassion.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Way honors the three treasures—above all compassion.

sentences.zh: 活萬戶之傷夷，息六師之勞瘁。

translations.literal: Revive the wounded and maimed of ten thousand households, and rest the weariness of the six armies.
translations.idiomatic: To heal ten thousand wounded households and spare the six armies exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 遂予仁憫，旌爾變通。

translations.literal: Therefore We grant compassionate mercy and mark your turn to change and adapt.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore grant mercy and mark your change of heart.

sentences.zh: 永貽子孫，長守富貴，敬佩光寵，可不美歟！

translations.literal: We bequeath this to your sons and grandsons forever; may you long keep wealth and honor, reverently esteeming this splendid favor—how could it not be beautiful!
translations.idiomatic: May your sons and grandsons forever hold wealth and honor, revering this splendid favor—how fine a thing!

sentences.zh: 可復推誠奉義佐運致理功臣、天雄軍節度、管內觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、守太傅、兼中書令、廣晉尹、上柱國、臨清王，食邑一萬戶，食實封一千戶，改授鄆州刺史、天平軍節度、鄆齊

translations.literal: He may be restored as Merit Subject Who Sincerely Serves Righteousness and Assists the Mandate in Ordering the Realm, Military Governor of the Tianxiong Army, Commissioner of Circuit Observation and Disposition, Grand Preceptor of State with Equal Rites to the Three Dukes, Acting Grand Mentor, Concurrent Director of the Central Secretariat, Mayor of Guangjin, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Linqing, with a fief of ten thousand households and actual enfeoffment of one thousand, and transferred to Prefect of Yanzhou, Military Governor of the Tianping Army, Yan and Qi
translations.idiomatic: He may be restored as Merit Subject Who Sincerely Serves Righteousness, Military Governor of Tianxiong, Commissioner of Circuit Observation, Vice Counselor equal to the Three Dukes, Acting Grand Mentor, Director of the Central Secretariat, Mayor of Guangjin, Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of Linqing, fief of ten thousand households with one thousand actual, and transferred to Prefect of Yanzhou, Military Governor of Tianping, Yan and Qi

sentences.zh: （原本闕一字。）〉

translations.literal: (One character is missing in the original text.)]
translations.idiomatic: (One character is missing in the original.)]

sentences.zh: 等州觀察處置等使，賜鐵券，改封高平郡王，仍令擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: As Commissioner of Observation and Disposition for these prefectures, granted an iron covenant, enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoping Commandery, and ordered to choose a day for full investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: As Commissioner of Observation for these prefectures, granted an iron covenant, enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoping, with investiture on a chosen day.

sentences.zh: 」以天雄軍節度副使、檢校刑部尚書李式檢校尚書右僕射，充亳州團練使；

translations.literal: " Li Shi, Deputy Military Governor of the Tianxiong Army and Honorary Vice Minister of Justice, was made Honorary Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and appointed regimental commissioner of Bozhou;
translations.idiomatic: " Li Shi, deputy military governor of Tianxiong and Honorary Vice Minister of Justice, became Honorary Right Vice Director of State Affairs and regimental commissioner of Bo;

sentences.zh: 以貝州刺史孫漢威為檢校太保、隴州防禦使；

translations.literal: Sun Hanwei, Prefect of Beizhou, was made Honorary Grand Guardian and Defense Commissioner of Longzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hanwei, Prefect of Bei, became Honorary Grand Guardian and Defense Commissioner of Long;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍三城都巡檢使薛霸為檢校司空、衛州刺史；

translations.literal: Xue Ba, Chief Metropolitan Inspector of the Three Cities of the Tianxiong Army, was made Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Weizhou;
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ba, chief metropolitan inspector of Tianxiong's three cities, became Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Wei;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍馬步軍都指揮使五建為檢校司空、虢州刺史；

translations.literal: Wang Jian, Commander of Horse and Foot Forces of the Tianxiong Army, was made Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Guozhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian, commander of horse and foot of Tianxiong, became Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Guo;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍內外馬軍都指揮使藥元福為檢校司空、深州刺史；

translations.literal: Yao Yuanfu, Commander of Inner and Outer Cavalry of the Tianxiong Army, was made Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Shenzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanfu, commander of inner and outer cavalry of Tianxiong, became Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Shen;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍內外步軍都指揮使安元霸為檢校司空、隨州刺史；

translations.literal: An Yuanba, Commander of Inner and Outer Infantry of the Tianxiong Army, was made Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Suizhou;
translations.idiomatic: An Yuanba, commander of inner and outer infantry of Tianxiong, became Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Sui;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍都監、前河陽行軍司馬李彥珣為檢校司空、坊州刺史。

translations.literal: Li Yanxun, Army Supervisor of the Tianxiong Army and former Campaign Secretary of Heyang, was made Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanxun, army supervisor of Tianxiong and former campaign secretary of Heyang, became Honorary Grand Master and Prefect of Fang.

sentences.zh: 李式，延光之舊僚也，其餘皆延光之將佐也，故有是命。

translations.literal: Li Shi was Yanguang's old colleague; the rest were all Yanguang's generals and aides, hence these appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi was Yanguang's old colleague; the rest were his generals and aides, hence these appointments.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣客省使李守貞押器幣賜魏府立功將校。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Reception Commissioner Li Shouzhen was sent escorting vessels and gifts to bestow on meritorious officers of Weifu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Reception Commissioner Li Shouzhen was sent with vessels and gifts for meritorious officers of Weifu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以魏府招討使楊光遠檢校太師、兼中書令，行廣晉尹，充天雄軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Yang Guangyuan, Pacification Commissioner of Weifu, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Director of the Central Secretariat, Acting Mayor of Guangjin, and Military Governor of the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yang Guangyuan, pacification commissioner of Weifu, became Honorary Grand Preceptor, Director of the Central Secretariat, Acting Mayor of Guangjin, and Military Governor of Tianxiong.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，福建節度使王繼恭遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on yihai, Wang Jigong, Military Governor of Fujian, sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yihai, Wang Jigong of Fujian sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，契丹命使以寶冊上帝徽號曰英武明義皇帝。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Khitan envoys bearing the precious register invested the Emperor with the honorific title Heroic Martial and Enlightened Righteous Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Khitan envoys with the precious register invested the emperor as Heroic Martial and Enlightened Righteous Emperor.

sentences.zh: （《歐陽史》作契丹使中書令韓頻來奉冊。）〉

translations.literal: (The History of Ouyang Xiu records that the Khitan envoy, Director of the Central Secretariat Han Pin, came to present the register.)]
translations.idiomatic: (Ouyang Xiu's History records that the Khitan envoy, Director of the Central Secretariat Han Pin, came to present the register.)]

sentences.zh: 是日，左右金吾、六軍儀仗、太常鼓吹等並出城迎引至崇元殿前，陳列如儀。

translations.literal: That day, the Left and Right Golden Crow Guards, the six armies' ceremonial guards, and the Directorate of Music's processional music all went out of the city to welcome and escort them to before the Chongyuan Hall, arrayed according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the Golden Crow Guards, the six armies' ceremonial guards, and the Directorate of Music's processional music escorted them to the Chongyuan Hall in full ritual array.

sentences.zh: 鄆州範延光奏到任內。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou memorialized that he had assumed office within his circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou reported that he had taken up his post.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，御劄曰：「為國之規，在於敏政；

translations.literal: On gengchen, an imperial rescript stated: "The rule for governing a state lies in diligent administration;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an imperial rescript read: "The rule of state lies in diligent government;

sentences.zh: 建都之法，務要利民。

translations.literal: the method of establishing a capital must above all benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: the method of establishing a capital must benefit the people.

sentences.zh: 歷考前經，朗然通論，顧惟涼德，獲啟丕基。

translations.literal: Examining the former classics throughout, the principle is clear; reflecting on Our meager virtue, We have been enabled to open a great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: The classics are clear on this; reflecting on Our modest virtue, We have been enabled to found the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 當數朝戰伐之餘，是兆庶傷殘之後，車徒既廣，帑廩鹹虛。

translations.literal: At a time when several reigns of warfare have just ended, when the myriad people are still wounded and broken, chariots and followers are already numerous, and the treasury and granaries are all empty.
translations.idiomatic: After generations of warfare, with the people still wounded, armies already vast, and treasury and granaries empty.

sentences.zh: 經年之免粟飛芻，繼日而勞民動眾，常煩漕運，不給供須。

translations.literal: Year after year exempting grain and flying fodder, day after day laboring the people and moving the masses, constantly troubling canal transport, unable to meet supply needs.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year grain and fodder must be levied, day after day the people are burdened, canal transport is constantly strained, and supplies cannot be met.

sentences.zh: 今汴州水陸要沖，山河形勝，乃萬庾千箱之地，是四通八達之郊。

translations.literal: Now Bianzhou is a vital junction of water and land routes, with mountains and rivers in commanding terrain; it is a land of ten thousand granaries and a thousand storehouses, a suburb reaching in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou is now a vital junction of water and land, with commanding terrain; it is a land of abundant granaries and a hub reaching in all directions.

sentences.zh: 爰自按巡，益觀宜便，俾升都邑，以利兵民。

translations.literal: Since We personally inspected it on tour, We have further seen its convenience; let it be raised to capital status to benefit soldiers and people.
translations.idiomatic: Since Our inspection tour, its advantages are clear; let it be raised to the capital to benefit army and people.

sentences.zh: 汴州宜升為東京，置開封府。

translations.literal: Bianzhou should be elevated to the Eastern Capital and the Kaifeng Prefecture established.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou is elevated to the Eastern Capital and the Kaifeng Prefecture established.

sentences.zh: 仍升開封、浚儀兩縣為赤縣，其餘升為畿縣。

translations.literal: Further, Kaifeng and Junyi counties are both raised to imperial counties; the rest are raised to metropolitan counties.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng and Junyi counties are raised to imperial counties; the rest to metropolitan counties.

sentences.zh: 應舊置開封府時所管屬縣，並可仍舊割屬收管，亦升為畿縣。

translations.literal: All counties formerly under the jurisdiction of the Kaifeng Prefecture when it was first established may continue to be assigned and administered as before, and are also raised to metropolitan counties.
translations.idiomatic: All counties formerly under Kaifeng Prefecture are reassigned as before and also raised to metropolitan counties.

sentences.zh: 其洛京改為西京；

translations.literal: Luoyang is changed to the Western Capital;
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang is renamed the Western Capital;

sentences.zh: 其雍京改為晉昌軍，留守改為節度觀察使，依舊為京兆府，列在七府之上；

translations.literal: Yongjing is changed to the Jinchang Army; the garrison commissioner is changed to military governor and observation commissioner; it remains the Jingzhao Prefecture, ranked above the seven prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Yongjing becomes the Jinchang Army; the garrison commissioner becomes military governor and observation commissioner; Jingzhao Prefecture remains, ranked above the seven prefectures;

sentences.zh: 其曹州改為防禦州。

translations.literal: Caozhou is changed to a defense prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cao is changed to a defense prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其餘制置，並委中書門下商量施行。

translations.literal: All other arrangements are entrusted to the Secretariat and Chancellery to deliberate and implement.
translations.idiomatic: All other arrangements are entrusted to the Secretariat and Chancellery to implement.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，以護聖左廂都指揮使、曹州刺史張彥澤為鎮國軍節度使，以工部尚書裴皞為尚書右僕射致仕。

translations.literal: " On bingxu, Zhang Yanze, Commander of the Left Wing of the Imperial Guard and Prefect of Caozhou, was made Military Governor of the Zhenguo Army; Pei Hao, Minister of Works, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and retired.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu, Zhang Yanze, commander of the left wing of the Imperial Guard and Prefect of Cao, became military governor of Zhenguo; Pei Hao, Minister of Works, retired as Right Vice Director of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔改大寧宮門為明德門。

translations.literal: That day, an edict changed the Daning Palace Gate to the Gate of Bright Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: That day, an edict renamed the Daning Palace Gate the Gate of Bright Virtue.

sentences.zh: 又改京城諸門名額，南門尉氏以薰風為名，西二門鄭門、梁門以金義、乾明為名，北二門酸棗門、封丘門以元化、宣陽為名，東二門曹門、宋門以迎春、仁和為名。

translations.literal: The name plaques of the capital's gates were also changed: the southern Weishi Gate was named Fragrant Breeze; the two western gates, Zheng Gate and Liang Gate, were named Golden Righteousness and Qianming; the two northern gates, Sour Jujube Gate and Fengqiu Gate, were named Primal Transformation and Xuanyang; the two eastern gates, Cao Gate and Song Gate, were named Welcoming Spring and Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's gate names were also changed: the southern Weishi Gate became Fragrant Breeze; the western Zheng and Liang gates became Golden Righteousness and Qianming; the northern Sour Jujube and Fengqiu gates became Primal Transformation and Xuanyang; the eastern Cao and Song gates became Welcoming Spring and Renhe.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以右金吾大將軍馬從斌為契丹國信使，考功郎中劉知新副之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Ma Congbin, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, was made credence envoy to the Khitan; Liu Zhixin, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, served as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Ma Congbin, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, became credence envoy to the Khitan, with Liu Zhixin, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, as deputy.

sentences.zh: 以前天平軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事安審琦為晉昌軍節度使，行京兆尹。

translations.literal: An Shenqi, former Military Governor of the Tianping Army, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and Grand Councilor, was made Military Governor of the Jinchang Army and Acting Mayor of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi, former military governor of Tianping, Honorary Grand Preceptor, and Grand Councilor, became military governor of Jinchang and Acting Mayor of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 襄州奏，江水漲害稼。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture reported that the Yangtze rose and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang reported that the Yangtze rose and damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以樞密使、中書侍郎平章事、集賢殿大學士桑維翰兼兵部尚書，皆罷樞密使。

translations.literal: On renchen, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Minister of the Central Secretariat with Grand Councilor status, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, was made concurrent Minister of War; all were removed from the post of Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of Military Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, was made concurrent Minister of War; all were removed as Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: （案：以上疑有闕文。

translations.literal: (Note: The text above is suspected of having lacunae.
translations.idiomatic: (Note: The passage above is suspected of lacunae.

sentences.zh: 據《通鑒考異》引《晉高祖實錄》，維翰與李崧並罷樞密使。）〉

translations.literal: According to the Comprehensive Mirror's textual notes citing the Veritable Records of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, both Weihan and Li Song were removed as Commissioners of Military Affairs.)]
translations.idiomatic: According to the Comprehensive Mirror's textual notes citing the Veritable Records of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, both Weihan and Li Song were removed as Commissioners of Military Affairs.)]

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦天下，以魏府初平故也。

translations.literal: On wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm because Weifu had just been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed because Weifu had just been pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚子，楊光遠朝覲到闕，對於便殿，錫賫甚厚。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Yang Guangyuan arrived at court for an audience; he was received in the side hall and richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Guangyuan arrived for an audience; he was received in the side hall and richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 于闐國王李聖天冊封為大寶于闐國王。

translations.literal: Li Shengtian, King of Khotan, was invested by register as King of Great Treasure Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shengtian, King of Khotan, was invested as King of Great Treasure Khotan.

sentences.zh: 以杭州嘉興縣為秀州，從錢元瓘之奏也。

translations.literal: Jiaxing County of Hangzhou was made Xiuzhou, following Qian Yuanguan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing County of Hangzhou was made Xiuzhou, at Qian Yuanguan's request.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，樞密直學士、祠部員外郎吳涓進金部郎中、知制誥，樞密直學士、庫部員外郎吳承範進祠部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Wu Juan, Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites, was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Revenue and made Drafter of Imperial Rescripts; Wu Chengfang, Academician Direct of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue, was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Rites and made Drafter of Imperial Rescripts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Wu Juan, direct academician of Military Affairs and Vice Director of Rites, became Director of Revenue and drafter of rescripts; Wu Chengfang, direct academician of Military Affairs and Vice Director of Revenue, became Director of Rites and drafter of rescripts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鄆州範延光來朝。

translations.literal: On yisi, Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封閩王昶為閩國王，加食邑一萬五千戶。

translations.literal: On bingwu, King Chang of Min was enfeoffed as King of Min, with an added fief of fifteen thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, King Chang of Min was enfeoffed as King of Min, with an added fief of fifteen thousand households.

sentences.zh: 又以中吳建武等軍節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、蘇州誠州刺史錢元尞為太傅，以清海軍節度使、廣州刺史錢元璹為檢校太尉、兼中書令，仍改名元懿。

translations.literal: Further, Qian Yuanliao, Military Governor of the Zhongwu and Jianwu Armies, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Director of the Central Secretariat, and Prefect of Chengzhou in Suzhou, was made Grand Tutor; Qian Yuanshuang, Military Governor of the Qinghai Army and Prefect of Guangzhou, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Director of the Central Secretariat, and his name was changed to Yuanyi.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanliao, military governor of Zhongwu and Jianwu, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Director of the Central Secretariat, and Prefect of Cheng in Suzhou, became Grand Tutor; Qian Yuanshuang, military governor of Qinghai and Prefect of Guangzhou, became Honorary Grand Preceptor and Director of the Central Secretariat, and was renamed Yuanyi.

sentences.zh: 應有魏府行營將校及六軍諸道、本城將校等，並與加恩。

translations.literal: All officers of the Weifu campaign army, the six armies, the various circuits, and the capital garrison were likewise granted favors.
translations.idiomatic: All officers of the Weifu campaign army, the six armies, the circuits, and the capital garrison were likewise rewarded.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以門下侍郎平章事、監修國史、判戶部趙瑩兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On wushen, Zhao Ying, Vice Minister of the Secretariat with Grand Councilor status, Supervisor of the National History, and Overseer of the Ministry of Revenue, was made concurrent Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhao Ying, Grand Councilor, supervisor of the national history, and overseer of Revenue, was made concurrent Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以威武軍節度、福建管內觀察處置等使王繼恭為特進、檢校太傅，仍封臨海郡王。

translations.literal: Wang Jigong, Military Governor of the Weiwu Army and Commissioner of Circuit Observation and Disposition within Fujian, was made Special Advancement and Honorary Grand Tutor, and was further enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jigong, military governor of Weiwu and commissioner of Fujian, was made Special Advancement and Honorary Grand Tutor, and enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 以魏博節度使楊光遠為守太尉、洛京留守，兼河陽節度使，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan, Military Governor of Weibo, was made Acting Grand Preceptor, Garrison Commissioner of Luoyang, and concurrent Military Governor of Heyang, with charge of the six armies and palace guards.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Weibo, became Acting Grand Preceptor, Garrison Commissioner of Luoyang, and concurrent military governor of Heyang, with charge of the six armies and palace guards.

sentences.zh: 端明殿學士、尚書禮部侍郎、判度支和凝改尚書戶部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: He Ning, Academician of the Duanming Hall, Vice Minister of Rites in the Department of State Affairs, and Overseer of the Bureau of Public Revenue, was changed to Vice Minister of Revenue in the Department of State Affairs to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall, Vice Minister of Rites, and overseer of Public Revenue, became Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，鄆州範延光上表乞休退，詔不允。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou submitted a memorial begging to retire; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou asked to retire; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升廣晉府為鄴都，置留守。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Guangjin Prefecture was elevated to Yedu and a garrison commissioner was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Guangjin Prefecture was elevated to Yedu and a garrison commissioner appointed.

sentences.zh: 升廣晉、元城兩縣為赤縣，屬府諸縣升為畿縣。

translations.literal: Guangjin and Yuancheng counties were both raised to imperial counties; all counties under the prefecture were raised to metropolitan counties.
translations.idiomatic: Guangjin and Yuancheng counties were raised to imperial counties; all counties under the prefecture to metropolitan counties.

sentences.zh: 升相州為彰德軍，置節度觀察使，以澶、衛二州為屬郡，其澶州仍升為防禦州，移於德勝口為治所。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou was elevated to the Zhangde Army, with a military governor and observation commissioner appointed; Chan and Wei prefectures were made subordinate circuits; Chan was further raised to a defense prefecture, with its seat moved to Desheng Ford.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou was elevated to the Zhangde Army with a military governor and observation commissioner; Chan and Wei were made subordinate circuits; Chan was raised to a defense prefecture with its seat at Desheng Ford.

sentences.zh: 升貝州為永清軍，置節度觀察使，以博、冀二州為屬郡。

translations.literal: Bei Prefecture was elevated to the Yongqing Army, with a military governor and observation commissioner appointed; Bo and Ji prefectures were made subordinate circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Bei Prefecture was elevated to the Yongqing Army with a military governor and observation commissioner; Bo and Ji were made subordinate circuits.

sentences.zh: 以西京留守高行周為廣晉尹、鄴都留守；

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou, Garrison Commissioner of the Western Capital, was made Mayor of Guangjin and Garrison Commissioner of Yedu;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou, Luoyang regent, became Mayor of Guangjin and Garrison Commissioner of Yedu;

sentences.zh: 廣晉府行營中軍使、貝州防禦使王庭允加檢校太傅，充相州彰德軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wang Tingyun, Central Army Commissioner of the Guangjin campaign headquarters and Defense Commissioner of Bei Prefecture, was made Honorary Grand Tutor and appointed Military Governor of the Zhangde Army at Xiangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingyun, central army commissioner of the Guangjin campaign and defense commissioner of Bei, was made Honorary Grand Tutor and military governor of the Zhangde Army at Xiangzhou;

sentences.zh: 廣晉府行營步軍都指揮使、右神武統軍王周為貝州永清軍節度使。

translations.literal: Wang Zhou, Commander of the campaign infantry at the Guangjin headquarters and Commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was made Military Governor of the Yongqing Army at Bei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhou, campaign infantry commander at Guangjin and commander of the Right Shenwu Army, became military governor of the Yongqing Army at Bei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以範延光為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Fan Yanguang was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Fan Yanguang was appointed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以秘書監呂琦為禮部侍郎，歸德軍節度使趙在禮改天平軍節度使，昭義軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候杜重威改忠武軍節度使，忠武軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠改歸德軍節度使，前河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使侯益改昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Lu Qi, Director of the Palace Library, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili, Military Governor of the Guide Army, was transferred to Military Governor of the Tianping Army; Du Chongwei, Military Governor of Zhaoyi and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was transferred to Military Governor of the Zhongwu Army; Liu Zhiyuan, Military Governor of the Zhongwu Army and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was transferred to Military Governor of the Guide Army; Hou Yi, former Military Governor of Heyang with concurrent command of the left and right wings of the Fengguo Army, was transferred to Military Governor of Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Lu Qi, Director of the Palace Library, became Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili, governor of Guide, became governor of Tianping; Du Chongwei, governor of Zhaoyi and chief adjutant of the palace guard, became governor of Zhongwu; Liu Zhiyuan, governor of Zhongwu and commander-in-chief of the palace guard, became governor of Guide; and Hou Yi, former governor of Heyang and commander of the Fengguo left and right wings, became governor of Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，割濮州濮陽縣棣澶州。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, Puyang County of Pu Prefecture was detached and attached to Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Puyang County was detached from Pu Prefecture and attached to Chan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔許天下私鑄錢，以「天福元寶」為文。

translations.literal: An edict permitted private coinage throughout the realm, with the inscription "Tianfu Yuanbao."
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted private coinage empire-wide, with the legend "Tianfu Yuanbao."

sentences.zh: 丙寅冬至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the winter solstice, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; the guard of honor followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the winter solstice, the emperor entered the Chongyuan Hall for court congratulations, with the guard of honor arrayed according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌朔，以前兵部尚書梁文矩為太子太師，以鎮州節度副使符蒙為右諫議大夫，以吏部郎中曹國珍為左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, the jiaxu day, the former Minister of War Liang Wenju was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Fu Meng, Deputy Military Governor of Zhen Prefecture, was made Right Remonstrance Censor; Cao Guozhen, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Left Remonstrance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, jiaxu, the former Minister of War Liang Wenju became Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Fu Meng, deputy governor of Zhen, became Right Remonstrance Censor; and Cao Guozhen, Director in Personnel, became Left Remonstrance Censor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以前涇州彰義軍節度使李德充為晉州建雄軍節度使，加同平章事。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, the former Military Governor of the Zhangyi Army at Jing Prefecture, Li Dechong, was made Military Governor of the Jianxiong Army at Jin Prefecture and given the additional title of Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Dechong, former governor of the Zhangyi Army at Jing, became governor of the Jianxiong Army at Jin and was made Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 以皇太子右金吾衛上將軍重貴為檢校太傅、開封尹，封鄭王，加食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: Chonggui, Senior General of the Right Jinwu Guard of the Heir Apparent, was made Honorary Grand Tutor and Mayor of Kaifeng, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted an additional fief of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggui, senior general of the Heir Apparent's Right Jinwu Guard, was appointed Honorary Grand Tutor and Mayor of Kaifeng, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, with an additional fief of three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，制以大寶于闐國進奉使、檢校太尉馬繼榮為鎮國大將軍，使副黃門將軍、國子少監張再通為試衛尉卿，監使殿頭承旨、通事舍人吳順規為試將作少監。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, an order was issued that Ma Jirong, tribute envoy of Great Treasure Khotan and Honorary Grand Preceptor, be made Grand General Who Pacifies the State; Zhang Zaitong, Deputy Envoy, General of the Yellow Gate, and Vice Director of the Imperial Academy, be made Acting Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud; and Wu Shungui, Supervising Envoy, Palace Head Drafter, and Imperial Herald, be made Acting Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Ma Jirong, tribute envoy of Great Treasure Khotan and Honorary Grand Preceptor, was made Grand General Who Pacifies the State; Zhang Zaitong, deputy envoy, General of the Yellow Gate, and Vice Director of the Imperial Academy, was made Acting Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud; and Wu Shungui, supervising envoy, palace head drafter, and imperial herald, was made Acting Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.

sentences.zh: 回鶻使都督李萬金可歸義大將軍，監使雷德順為順化將軍。

translations.literal: Li Wanjinke, Commissioner-in-Chief of the Uyghur envoy mission, was made Grand General of Righteous Submission; Lei Deshun, Supervising Envoy, was made General of Harmonious Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wanjinke, commissioner-in-chief of the Uyghur mission, was made Grand General of Righteous Submission; Lei Deshun, supervising envoy, was made General of Harmonious Transformation.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「宜令天下無問公私，應有銅欲鑄錢者，一任取便酌量輕重鑄造。

translations.literal: That day, an edict stated: "Throughout the realm, without distinction of public or private, whoever has copper and wishes to cast coin may freely determine weight and fineness in casting.
translations.idiomatic: That day, an edict declared: "Throughout the realm, public or private, anyone with copper who wishes to cast coin may freely determine weight and fineness.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，以河陽潛龍舊宅為開晉禪院，邢州潛龍舊宅為廣法禪院。

translations.literal: " On the wuzi day, the former Hidden Dragon residence at Heyang was made the Kaijin Chan Monastery, and the former Hidden Dragon residence at Xing Prefecture was made the Guangfa Chan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuzi, the former Hidden Dragon residence at Heyang was made the Kaijin Chan Monastery, and the former Hidden Dragon residence at Xing Prefecture was made the Guangfa Chan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 龍武統軍李從昶卒，輟朝一日，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Li Congchang, Commander of the Longwu Army, died; court audiences were suspended for one day, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congchang, commander of the Longwu Army, died; the court suspended audiences for one day, and he was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor.
